records.name: Vera Verteilspiel
records.biography_en: She distributes chances according to a plan she is still improvising. She sets the courtyard's opportunities between her hands and calls them available or wasted. HyperNorm prefers distribution to look effortless. A dissonant card has made her place the next ball where the hesitant neighbour can reach it. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Vorlage ist gut. Für den weiteren Verlauf wird keine Haftung übernommen.

variant_notes.note_en: She distributes chances according to a plan she is still improvising.

records.name: Bert Blockbescheid
records.biography_en: He blocks incoming problems before establishing whether they were invitations. His raised palms stop complaints before they can be mistaken for invitations. The building classifies arrivals as manageable or blocked. A contradictory card has made him lower one hand long enough to hear what the visitor actually needed. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er blockt zuverlässig. Eine Anfrage wurde vorsorglich mit abgewehrt.

variant_notes.note_en: He blocks incoming problems before establishing whether they were invitations.

records.name: Sven Sandalarm
records.biography_en: He is ready to save the rally and deeply opposed to surprises. He holds the towel ready for a dive he hopes will remain theoretical. HyperNorm calls reflexes either commitment or panic. An ambiguous card has taught him that asking a neighbour to cover a gap can be a skilled response. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er ist abwehrbereit. Bitte greifen Sie ihn nicht mit Überraschungen an.

variant_notes.note_en: He is ready to save the rally and deeply opposed to surprises.

records.name: Ulf Aufschlagamt
records.biography_en: He treats the serve as a formal opening statement with physical consequences. The ball in his palm is the opening argument in a courtyard debate with very few listening rules. People are either receiving or obstructing. A dissonant card has made him wait until the neighbour opposite is ready. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Aufschlag eröffnet die Diskussion. Rücksicht ist weiterhin möglich.

variant_notes.note_en: He treats the serve as a formal opening statement with physical consequences.

records.name: Mira Mauerhöhe
records.biography_en: She doubts the net is high enough to justify all this enthusiasm. Her miniature net offers a portable explanation of where everybody ought to belong. HyperNorm calls boundaries clear or contested. A contradictory card has made her measure the space on both sides rather than merely defending her own. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Netzhöhe reicht. Das Niveau der Begeisterung liegt darüber.

variant_notes.note_en: She doubts the net is high enough to justify all this enthusiasm.

records.name: Fips FünfterSatz
records.biography_en: He entered for a casual game and is now part of a system. He brought a bottle for a casual afternoon and discovered a compulsory fifth set. Residents are either game or letting everyone down. An ambiguous card has given him the courage to suggest a drink before the next point. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Spiel ist locker. Der Zeitplan wurde deshalb vorsorglich aufgehoben.

variant_notes.note_en: He entered for a casual game and is now part of a system.
